headline: Kenvue (KVUE) Gets An FDA Lift On Tylenol As Valuation Looks Tight
summary: The FDA’s approval of Tylenol with Naproxen, a new over the counter pain reliever offering up to 12 hours of relief, has put Kenvue (KVUE) in focus after the stock gained about 2%. See our latest analysis for Kenvue. The FDA decision appears to have added to existing momentum in Kenvue’s stock, with a 90 day share price return of 10.23% and an 11.32% year to date share price return, even though the 1 year total shareholder return is down 11.67%.
